riskMeter.title: TANGEDCO Subsidy Risk Meter
riskMeter.subtitle: Clear, jargon-free visual tracking of your 200 free units and subsidized electricity tiers.
riskMeter.safeZoneDesc: You are well within the low-tariff subsidized tier. You receive 200 free units and low slab rates.
riskMeter.warningZoneDesc: Warning: You are approaching the 500-unit cutoff! If you cross 500 units, your 200 free units subsidy is cancelled and rates jump to ₹9/unit.
riskMeter.penaltyZoneDesc: Penalty Tier Active! You exceeded 500 units. Your 200 free units subsidy has been revoked and all units are billed at double rates.
riskMeter.safeZoneDescFull: First 200 units are completely free. Units between 201-400 are billed under highly subsidized telescopic rates (₹4.50/unit).
riskMeter.warningZoneDescFull: You are within 200 units of the 500-unit ceiling. Crossing 500 units will revoke your 200 free units and escalate all rates.
riskMeter.penaltyZoneDescFull: Zero free units granted. Entire consumption billed under non-subsidized rates up to ₹11.00/unit.
riskMeter.dynamicWarning: If you use {{units}} more units, you will lose your government subsidy and your rate will double.
riskMeter.penaltyWarning: You crossed the 500-unit threshold by {{units}} units! Reducing heavy appliances can restore your subsidy next billing cycle.
riskMeter.safeNotice: You have {{units}} units of buffer remaining before entering the warning zone. Keep up the efficient energy schedule!
riskMeter.domesticOnly: The 200 free units subsidy is provided by the Government of Tamil Nadu under GO Ms. No. 25/Energy for domestic residential connections.

insights.pageSubtitle: Predictive machine learning models, Subsidy Risk Meter, and plain-English anomaly alerts.
insights.noAnomalies: No abnormal spikes detected. Your electrical profile is stable within normal limits.
insights.safeTakeaway: Your consumption is safely inside the subsidized band. Maintaining this average will preserve your 200 free units and save you up to ₹1,450 compared to standard slabs.
insights.warningTakeaway: Warning: Your forecasted consumption crosses 500 units. Revoking the 200 free units subsidy triggers rates up to ₹11.00/unit.

tariff.title: Official TANGEDCO Tariff Structure
tariff.subtitle: Tariff schedules governed by the Tamil Nadu Electricity Regulatory Commission (TNERC).
tariff.telescopicNotice: Telescopic Billing: Lower slab rates apply up to 500 units with 200 free units subsidy.
tariff.commercialNotice: Non-Telescopic Billing: Consuming >100 units escalates all units to ₹10.45 flat + ₹110/kW demand charge.
tariff.industrialNotice: Industrial LT-IIIB: Flat ₹7.65/unit, ₹600/kW bi-monthly demand charge, and 5% Electricity Duty.

energyInbox.title: AI Energy Inbox
energyInbox.subtitle: Plain-English intelligence comparing historical bills, meter readings, and appliance loads
energyInbox.elevatedHealthDesc: {{diff}}% higher than last cycle. Keep heavy loads in check.
energyInbox.abnormalHealthDesc: {{diff}}% spike compared to your normal billing habits. Immediate action advised.
energyInbox.inboxZeroDesc: No unexplained leaks, velocity spikes, or seasonal risks are currently pending for this connection.
energyInbox.phantomLoadText: Your appliances should only use ~{{estimated}} units, but your meter shows {{actual}} units. You have a {{leak}}-unit leak. Check for older, inefficient appliances or wiring faults.
energyInbox.summerSpikeText: Based on your history, your usage typically jumps by {{jumpPercent}}% in April & May. Set your AC to 24°C instead of 18°C to avoid crossing the 500-unit penalty slab.
energyInbox.velocitySpikeText: You have used {{currentUnits}} units in just {{daysPassed}} days. At this pace, you will finish the cycle at {{projectedUnits}} units and lose your tier-1 subsidy.
energyInbox.velocityBufferText: You are burning {{dailyVelocity}} units/day ({{currentUnits}} kWh in {{daysPassed}} days). You only have an {{cushion}}-unit cushion remaining before crossing the 500-unit tariff cliff.
energyInbox.optimalText: Your household is tracking at an optimal ~{{dailyVelocity}} units/day. Staying on this track keeps you safely within the 200 free units subsidy zone.
energyInbox.howItWorksText: Instead of complex scatter plots, the platform compares your past bi-monthly bills, appliance profiler outputs, and 60-day velocity to protect your 200 free units subsidy under Tamil Nadu GO Ms. 25.
